description: Annual and monthly property tax from the home value minus any exemption, at the given tax rate, with assessed value and effective rate. Use when the user needs a property tax estimate from a home value and tax rate. For the full mortgage payment use calculate_mortgage. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive property tax estimator calculator.
